The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) points to a molecule containing about eight carbons. The formula that best fits these data is C₈H₈O (exact mass = 120.0575 Da, within ~10 ppm). I will now obtain the IR spectrum of the sample to see which functional groups are present (e.g., carbonyl, C‑O, aromatic C‑H, etc.) and then use that information to propose the correct SMILES.</thought>
